candidate.title: Mycl Ceo Adi Reza Nugroho Named People Of The Year 2026 By Metro Tv In Green And Sustainable Business

Mycotech.description: BLOCK71 Bandung-resident Indonesian biomaterials startup (founded 2015 by Adi Reza Nugroho and four co-founders, ITB-linked) using mycelium as a bio-adhesive to convert agricultural waste (cassava starch, corn bark, bagasse) into BIOBO interior boards and Mylea mycelium-leather for fashion and footwear. B-Corp since 2019. Solar Impulse Efficient Solution. Drop generic 'mycelium' / mushroom-cultivation articles unless they name MYCL.
